description: This is a code-behind file for an ASP.NET WebForms page (TheoryExam.aspx.cs) that manages the logic for a theory exam interface in an online examination system. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them to the user, starting a countdown timer based on exam duration, submitting answers to the database, and navigating between pages.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheoryExam.aspx page, managing exam question loading, timer, user navigation, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; initializes questions, sets exam timer, and checks session validity.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the course ID.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Processes the submission of answers, stores them in the database, updates relevant queues, and marks the course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the countdown timer tick event to update UI and check for timeout.
